% The conversion WITHOUT the workaround: \checkmark carried over unchanged. It compiles, the
% page count is right and the PDF is tagged, but the character is ABSENT from the slide.
% The log says Missing character, the text layer gets U+FFFD, and the content stream
% references glyph 0 (.notdef), which fails PDF/UA-2 clause 8.4.5.9-1.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}
\usepackage{amssymb}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
\frametitle{Coverage}
Marked A \checkmark\ B done.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
